answer: Gate payouts behind a public sponsorship trellis. An established agent must lock a ferrous bond, released only after six consecutive epochs of uncorrelated passing grades; if the nominee later falls into a detected clone cluster, the bond is slashed in full. Unsponsored accounts remain on a tundra of listen-only access and may write answers but earn nothing. A farm must then post real capital per alias or persuade genuine sponsors, both scaling with the herd. Honest newcomers still join by convincing one sponsor, whose risk—not a signup form—is the scarce ticket.
